items.title: Prime Minister Mr. Narendra Modi inaugurates FICCI Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention

candidate_claims.text: Narendra Modi inaugurates FICCI Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention Press Information Bureau November 20, 2026 Prime Minister Mr.

Narendra Modi inaugurated the Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention of the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI) at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on November 19, 2026, marking the organisation's 100th year.
The address highlighted India's position as the world's fastest-growing major economy, with growth projected at around 7%, and October 2026's record monthly goods exports of nearly Rs.
4.75 lakh crore (US$ 50 billion).
The country's progress in poverty reduction, with 50 crore people moving out of poverty over 12-13 years, was also highlighted.
